brief: Mike's overrides: NO longform this batch. Primarily focus ALL content on What If ($IF token) and Archie (the ARCHIE promo code). Make DOUBLE the default number of X tweet images. Make several tweets (with images) about the promo code, in lines like: 'Use promo code: ARCHIE to get 50% off your first month of my monthly community membership.' and 'Be a part of the endless onslaught of great calls without thinking, WHAT $IF I get rugged today?' Keep the $IF cashtag and the ARCHIE code exact. No em dashes.

fact_check.claim: Archie is the influencer face of $IF (transcript: 'Archie', 'the if guy', 'he fudded his own token'); the promo code is named after him
fact_check.verdict: verified that Archie (@CryptoArchieYT, YouTube 'Crypto Archie') is publicly the lead promoter of What If: the official @WhatIFonHOOD account advertised X Spaces 'with @CryptoArchieYT and the $IF community' and his channel carries 'Why Robinhood Chain Will DOMINATE + What $IF' (July 2026) and 'These Robinhood Chain Memes Are About to EXPLODE!' (Aug 24, 2026). Copy calls him 'the loudest voice behind $IF' / 'its loudest promoter'. The ARCHIE promo code and its 50%-off-first-month terms come from Mike's brief (counts as confirmed).

fact_check.claim: Archie put out a sell alert on his own $IF bag on Friday (Sept 18) and posted the reasons he had started to doubt the project; $IF was 'holding the line' before it (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: the sell alert itself is Mike's on-stream account (he read it on screen: 'he put out a sell alert and he stated all the reasons why he started to doubt his own project') and could NOT be independently found in press or search; it is CORROBORATED on-chain: the IF/WETH Uniswap pool opened Friday Sept 18 at $0.01044 and closed at $0.00236 (down 77.4%, intraday low $0.00154) on $4.34M volume, its biggest day since launch, after higher daily lows through September (Sept 3 low $0.0068, Sept 10 $0.0077, Sept 17 $0.0096). Copy states the sell alert as the event Mike watched and keeps every harsher on-stream characterization OUT (no 'clown', no 'child', no 'deleting comments', no 'screwed people over' as fact; 'I do not think he meant to screw anybody' is kept as Mike's view). Sept 18, 2026 is a Friday (checked).

fact_check.claim: $IF ($IF, What If, Robinhood Chain) market data used in copy: ~$24M cap at the Aug 2 top, ~$9M on Sept 17, down 77% on Sept 18, under $600K now, 98% off the high, down about 94% on the week
fact_check.verdict: verified and UPDATED to 2026-09-23: price $0.000657, market cap $588K to $594K (CoinGecko / DexScreener), 24h -20%, 7d -94.3%, 30d -93.0%, ATH $0.03899 on 2026-08-02, -98.3% from ATH; Phemex puts the Aug 2 closing cap at about $24.5M and Sept 15 at about $14.1M; Sept 17 close $0.01044 x ~905M circulating = about $9.4M ('about $9M'). Copy says 'about a $24M cap', 'about $9M', 'down 77% in one day', 'under $600K', '98% off the high'. Contract 0x232CDFc415D10b673845D83Dc02ba2eaBe7e30d1; main pool liquidity now $127K.

fact_check.claim: $IF project facts: launched July 11, 2026 on Robinhood Chain, 1B supply, ~9.5% burned, community takeover after the original dev left, official handle @WhatIFonHOOD
fact_check.verdict: verified (launch 2026-07-11 04:32 UTC, ten days after Robinhood Chain went public; 95.2M IF = 9.52% burned as of Sept 16; 'community members who arrived after the original developer departed'); none of these details are used as claims in the copy beyond the chain name and the handle. Follow line 'Follow: @WhatIFonHOOD' applied to every X tweet that mentions $IF per persona project_handles (mention-triggered); threads use the 'Follow me' CTA and carry no handle per the thread CTA rule.

fact_check.claim: Bitcoin made its first weekly close above the 50-week SMA in 45 weeks, weekly close $81,159 on Sept 20, 50-week SMA about $78,800; Bitcoin 'retracing a little' on stream (transcript: 'Bitcoin is retracing a little bit... not going back down to the 50')
fact_check.verdict: verified: weekly close $81,159 for the week ending Sept 20, 2026, 50-week SMA about $78,786, first close above it since Nov 9, 2025 (45 weeks). Bitcoin trades about $84,400 on 2026-09-23 (24h -2.4%), still above the line; no current BTC price is quoted in the copy.

fact_check.claim: Benjamin Cowen's 'I was wrong' video/post; his thesis chain (energy up -> yields up -> Fed hikes -> dollar up -> Bitcoin down) which he says he got right yet Bitcoin rose; his October-bottom call (transcript plays the video)
fact_check.verdict: verified: Cowen posted 'I was wrong. Not going to make excuses. I deserve to be dunked on.' on Sept 21, 2026; on Sept 8 he had 65% odds on the cycle low still being ahead, October as the window, with $44K in downside scenarios; press summaries of his video match the transcript's clip ('rising energy prices would increase bond yields, forcing the Fed to raise rates, followed by a stronger dollar and a decline in Bitcoin'). Copy: 'posted I was wrong on Sept 21', '65% odds on new lows with October as the window', 'energy up, yields up, the Fed hiking, the dollar up'. His 2023 $35K call and the 'humble' framing are not used.

fact_check.claim: Mike's community pricing and offer: regular VIP $59 a month, Premium $79 a month, promo code ARCHIE = 50% off the first month; site cryptorich.vip; what the membership includes (transcript + brief)
fact_check.verdict: VIP $59/month verified on Whop ('CryptoRich: VIP Membership', $59/ month). Premium $79 is Mike's own on-stream statement about his own product (the Whop store lists '+3 options' but the Premium page returned 404 to fetch), kept because the merchant's own price statement is authoritative. cryptorich.vip verified live: sign-up via Whop, offer lists new coin alerts, insider alerts, CEX listings, rug-pull detection, ATH and market-top alerts, automated trading tools/bots, Discord 'online for help like 24/7'; copy's inclusion list is drawn from that page plus Mike's 'swing trading software my members log into' statement. The promo code and the 50%-off terms are from Mike's brief.

fact_check.claim: Saturday's livestream was Mike's most viewed livestream ever, with the Archie thumbnail (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: Mike's own statement about his own channel (not externally checkable; YouTube channel pages return only footer to fetches). Written in first person as 'my most viewed livestream ever'; the Saturday is dated Sept 19 (the stream calls the promo-code idea 'yesterday' and says 'eight days left until October', placing the stream at Sept 22-23; batch date 2026-09-23).

fact_check.claim: This week a doxxed, honest dev announced (in a long tweet) he was closing his project to move to another one; Mike sent an urgent sell alert and the group got out; he had swing traded it so much he was not even down (transcript: 'burgers on base', 'burger money')
fact_check.verdict: Mike's own account of his own alert; the project is NOT named in the copy (general form: 'a doxxed dev I liked', 'closing his project down to move to another one') because the token could not be identified with confidence from the Whisper text. No numbers claimed.

fact_check.claim: The zombie thesis: almost everybody believed in a four-year cycle bear for the first time, so they caused one; holders dumped the whole way down; everybody buys back in October and front-runs it; 'everybody and their grandma' (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: Mike's own macro thesis, written in first person as his read. His on-stream '90% of people' estimate is softened to 'almost the entire market' (no verifiable stat). The checkonchain 1-to-1,000 BTC cohort claim ('first time in history they dumped while price fell') is NOT used (unverified).

fact_check.claim: Archie described friends with millions waiting to buy the first week of October no matter what (transcript)
fact_check.verdict: Mike's report of what he heard Archie say ('I have heard Archie describe friends of his... millions of dollars, getting ready for October'); written as 'I have heard him describe', attributed, no figure beyond 'millions'.

fact_check.claim: Whisper corrections applied: 'what if' -> What If / $IF (never the long-form ticker spelling), 'the 50' -> 50-week SMA, 'fretted/fudded' -> FUD, 'cell alert' -> sell alert, 'Benjamin Cowan' -> Benjamin Cowen, '200-week movement average' -> 200-week SMA
fact_check.verdict: applied throughout; none of the persona-listed Whisper mishears (the TAO, Kaspa and cyan ones) appear in the copy.

fact_check.claim: Dropped from the batch: Orbeo ('this is where we got in'), the 'grand bag' add question, NVM on Robinhood Chain (fake-project anecdote), Crypto Galaxy / Crypto John / Blaze, Sui, Arc chain / Argus volume, the Kaspa 7-cent vindication aside, Dan Gambardello, Mike's Roku-channel history, the wife-beating analogy
fact_check.verdict: outside the brief's focus ($IF and Archie), unverifiable as named claims, already-told position changes, or off-register; not drafted.

fact_check.claim: Brief line 'WHAT $IF I get rugged today?'
fact_check.verdict: used with the day-relative word removed ('WHAT $IF I get rugged?') because the validator and persona ban 'today' in queue copy (posts go out days after the stream); the $IF cashtag and the ARCHIE code are kept exact everywhere.

Archie knows this. I have heard him describe friends with millions waiting to buy the first week of October no matter what. And with that on the calendar, he hit sell on his own $IF bag and posted the reasons he had started to doubt his own project.

$IF had been holding higher lows since early September, about a $9M cap on Sept 17. On Sept 18 it fell 77% in one day. This week it sits under a $600K cap, 98% below the Aug 2 high. That is a lot of real people who got hurt.

I do not think he meant to screw anybody. I think he just did not think, and that is the lesson: you avoid the most severe mistakes by thinking before you act, not after.
